headline: CSRD assurance consultation launched alongside ESPR DPP guidance and CBAM proposals
summary: The European Commission has opened a consultation on CSRD limited assurance standards and published technical guidance on Digital Product Passports. Additionally, rules on non-EU carbon price deductions under CBAM were finalised, alongside proposed extensions to downstream products. A Machinery Regulation corrigendum was also published.

items.title: Commission consults on CSRD limited assurance standards
items.what: The European Commission launched a public consultation on limited assurance standards for CSRD reporting.
items.meaning: As an in-scope entity for financial year 2027 reporting, these standards will define the mandatory audit depth for sustainability disclosures.
items.action: Review draft assurance expectations to align internal reporting controls with external auditors.

sources.title: EU CSRD: Commission consults on limited assurance standards, Julia Voskoboinikova

items.title: EU releases DPP technical resources and EU-China data white paper
items.what: The Commission published six technical resources for DPP registry connectivity, alongside a joint EU-China white paper on DPP data interoperability.
items.meaning: Clarifies the technical architecture for supply chain data exchange with Chinese manufacturers ahead of future product passport obligations.
items.action: Assess DPP connectivity specifications with IT teams and Chinese suppliers.

sources.title: Commission publishes six technical resources for companies connecting to the digital product passport registry
China, EU release DPP interoperability white paper to facilitate data connectivity

items.title: CBAM third-country deduction rules finalised; downstream extension proposed
items.what: The EU adopted rules for deducting third-country carbon costs—recognising China's ETS—and outlined a proposed CBAM extension to 180 downstream steel and aluminium products.
items.meaning: Importing finished tools currently avoids direct CBAM duties, but proposed downstream scope extensions could eventually capture finished hardware.
items.action: Monitor proposed downstream product lists and track embedded emissions data from suppliers.

sources.title: EU industrial emissions fall as Commission outlines proposed CBAM extension to 180 downstream steel and aluminium products
EU Recognizes China’s Carbon Market for Border Levy Deductions
EU sets rules for deducting third-country carbon costs under CBAM, recognizes Turkey’s ETS

items.title: Official corrigendum published for EU Machinery Regulation
items.what: An official corrigendum to Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 was published in the Official Journal.
items.meaning: Provides minor technical corrections ahead of mandatory application in January 2027.
items.action: Check corrigendum text against internal technical documentation and compliance templates.

items.title: Council adopts simplification law for chemical product regulations
items.what: The Council of the EU adopted a law aimed at streamlining and simplifying rules governing chemical products.
items.meaning: Simplifies administrative compliance workflows for chemical rules relevant to tool components and packaging.
items.action: Verify operational impact with product safety teams.
